title: Mini AI News Agent
tagline: Autonomous daily tech newsletter curated by AI agents with personalized briefings
description: A lightweight news aggregation agent that monitors 200+ sources (RSS, Twitter, GitHub, HackerNews, ArXiv), filters for relevance using embeddings, clusters related stories, generates summaries with citations, and delivers personalized daily briefings via email/Slack/Notion. Open source, self-hostable.
problem: Tech professionals drown in information. Manual curation takes 30min/day. Existing newsletters are generic. Need: personalized relevance, source diversity, actionable summaries, zero maintenance.
solution: Cron job (daily 6AM): 1) Fetch from 200+ sources via RSS/API, 2) Dedupe + embed (BGE-small), 3) Cluster (HDBSCAN) → story groups, 4) Relevance scoring per user profile (embeddings + keywords), 5) Top-k per cluster → GPT-4o-mini summary with citations, 6) Render HTML/Markdown → deliver (SendGrid/Slack/Notion API). User onboarding: OAuth + interest embedding from GitHub/LinkedIn.
architecture: Single binary (Go) + SQLite: Fetcher (concurrent) → Embedder (ONNX runtime) → Clusterer → Scorer → Summarizer (OpenAI batch) → Renderer → Delivery. Deployed on Fly.io (free tier). Config: YAML. Extensible source plugins.
lessonsLearned: HDBSCAN on embeddings creates coherent clusters without predefined categories
User interest embeddings from GitHub stars beat explicit topic selection
